tests.name: string_view_conversion_operator
tests.intent: Probes whether a custom type with an explicit conversion operator to std::string_view can be used directly as a key in operator[] lookup.

tests.name: string_view_implicit_convertible
tests.intent: Tests if a class implicitly convertible to std::string_view works with basic_json operator[] for object element access.

tests.name: string_view_const_reference_access
tests.intent: Ensures that const reference operator[] works correctly with types convertible to std::string_view.

tests.name: string_view_non_object_exception
tests.intent: Checks the exception message behavior when operator[] with a string_view convertible custom type is called on a non-object json value.

tests.name: string_view_key_mutation
tests.intent: Probes whether write access via operator[] works correctly using a custom type convertible to std::string_view on an existing key.

tests.name: string_view_key_insertion
tests.intent: Probes whether insertion of a new element via operator[] works correctly using a custom type convertible to std::string_view.

tests.name: string_view_at_method_comparison
tests.intent: Checks if the at() member function and operator[] behave consistently for types convertible to std::string_view.

tests.name: is_usable_as_basic_json_key_trait
tests.intent: Directly probes the type trait is_usable_as_basic_json_key_type with a user-defined type convertible to std::string_view.

tests.name: string_view_subscript_rvalue
tests.intent: Examines rvalue usage of a custom type convertible to std::string_view in nested operator[] expressions.

tests.name: multiple_string_view_conversions
tests.intent: Verifies overloading resolution and unambiguous behavior when multiple distinct user-defined types convertible to std::string_view are used.

tests.name: string_view_inherited_conversion
tests.intent: Tests a class hierarchy where the base class provides the operator std::string_view used for JSON key lookup.

tests.name: string_view_explicit_bool_conversion
tests.intent: Ensures that types having both bool conversion and string_view conversion do not break operator[] disambiguation.

tests.name: string_view_key_find
tests.intent: Tests whether find() works consistently with operator[] for a user type convertible to std::string_view.

tests.name: string_view_key_contains
tests.intent: Examines contains() behavior with std::string_view conversion types.

tests.name: string_view_ordered_json
tests.intent: Ensures that nlohmann::ordered_json also correctly handles custom types convertible to std::string_view in operator[].

tests.name: string_view_temporary_lifetime
tests.intent: Probes temporary lifetime handling when constructing a custom viewable key inline within operator[].

tests.name: string_view_empty_key
tests.intent: Tests operator[] lookup using a custom type convertible to an empty std::string_view.

tests.name: string_view_special_characters
tests.intent: Checks operator[] with a custom viewable key containing special characters and escapes.

tests.name: string_view_conversion_noexcept
tests.intent: Tests a noexcept conversion operator to std::string_view used inside basic_json operator[].

tests.name: string_view_pointer_conversion_fallback
tests.intent: Probes behavior when a class provides both a pointer conversion and a string_view conversion.
